Name: Berry Season Calendar Reminder
Author: xihanovo
Description:
[b]Berry Season Reminder[/b] is a simple mod that adds icons to the calendar to remind you about berry season.  Never let it sneak up on you again!
This functionality is unlocked when you earn [i]Bear's Knowledge[/i]--thanks Mr. Bear!
[b]
The main changes in this version are:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]i18n support[/b]: Added translation files, so the mod can now display berry season names in multiple languages.[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) integration[/b]: You can now configure the mod's options in-game via the GMCM menu, without editing the config file manually.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Berry Season Reminder Alternative
Manifest.Description: Adds berry season icons to your calendar after receiving Bear's Knowledge.
